summary:
Fixed the hash collision bug.

Changed [Product.java](/app/src/Product.java:31) so `hashCode()` uses `sku`, matching `equals()`. Updated [ProductCache.java](/app/src/ProductCache.java:86) so bucket indexing and resizing hash directly on SKU with `Math.floorMod`.

Verification: `javac -d classes src/*.java && ./test.sh` passes. The distribution check now reports max chain length `4` instead of `1000`.
